settings.whatsNew.title: What’s new
whatsNew.title: New in Grynd {{version}}
whatsNew.text: Here’s what changed with this update.
whatsNew.page.title: What’s new
releaseNotes.duplicatePlan.title: Duplicate plans
releaseNotes.duplicatePlan.text: Need a similar plan? Open a plan for editing and choose “Duplicate plan” in the menu at the top right. Adjust the name, weekdays and exercises before you save.
releaseNotes.exerciseSearch.title: Find exercises faster
releaseNotes.exerciseSearch.text: Search and filters now stay at the top while you scroll. Tap a muscle group, pick equipment from the menu below it, or just type «chest dumbbell» into the search.
releaseNotes.notePhotos.title: Photos in notes
releaseNotes.notePhotos.text: Add up to six photos to an exercise note, like your seat setting. They stay on your device and are just for you.
releaseNotes.whatsNew.title: What’s new at a glance
releaseNotes.whatsNew.text: After an update, Grynd briefly shows you what’s new. You can find all changes any time in the settings under “What’s new”.
releaseNotes.pauseWorkout.title: Pause your workout
releaseNotes.pauseWorkout.text: Need a break? Tap pause at the top: the workout clock stands still until you continue. In the meantime you can use the app as usual; your workout waits for you above the navigation.
releaseNotes.weightStep.title: Your own weight step per exercise
releaseNotes.weightStep.text: Dumbbells in 2 kg steps, machines in 5 kg? Choose per exercise how much + and − change the weight, from the exercise menu during a workout or in the plan.
releaseNotes.exerciseNotes.title: Exercise notes
releaseNotes.exerciseNotes.text: Jot down seat settings, grip or technique tips for an exercise. The note shows up right above your sets during the workout, in every plan with that exercise.
releaseNotes.workoutPercent.title: Progress in percent
releaseNotes.workoutPercent.text: The top of the workout screen now shows how much you’ve already done.
releaseNotes.valueScrubber.title: Drag to change values
releaseNotes.valueScrubber.text: Slide your finger sideways over weight or reps. A ruler shows every step, so you hit the right value quickly and precisely.
releaseNotes.setMenu.title: Adjust sets faster
releaseNotes.setMenu.text: Tap the set number to duplicate or delete a set. Deleted a planned set? “+ Set” brings it back.
releaseNotes.narrowPhones.title: Fits small phones too
releaseNotes.narrowPhones.text: Sets now fit on very narrow screens without anything being cut off.
releaseNotes.workoutClock.title: Workout clock
releaseNotes.workoutClock.text: The top right shows how long you’ve been training. Tap it when you want to end your workout.
releaseNotes.historyStats.title: Statistics in your history
releaseNotes.historyStats.text: A calendar of your training days, numbers per week, month and year, your strength progress per exercise and which muscle groups you train.
releaseNotes.compareWorkouts.title: Compare workouts
releaseNotes.compareWorkouts.text: Every workout shows what changed since the last time you did the same plan. You can also see all workouts of a plan at a glance.
releaseNotes.celebrations.title: Little celebrations
releaseNotes.celebrations.text: A check mark that pops, stars for new records and confetti when you finish an exercise or your whole workout.
releaseNotes.firstRelease.title: Grynd is here
releaseNotes.firstRelease.text: Build plans, check off sets with one tap (your numbers from last time are already filled in), rest timer and history. No ads, no account, everything stays on your device.
picker.discard.title: Discard selection?
picker.discard.text: The selected exercises will not be added.
